text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I... lost again.
I couldn't stand center stage this time either...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Falco doesn't want things to stay like this!
I'm gonna train harder and harder so I can win!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'm definitely going to become a top Umadol
who brings dreams and hope to everyone!!
choice_data_list: Rushing too much won't do you any good.
It's not good to rush too much.
Yeah! Show us your Umadol spirit!
Yeah! Show them your Umadol spirit!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
But...! I've been losing over and over,
so of course I'm gonna panic...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Falco wants to be able to win right now!
I've gotta switch over to spartan umadol mode!"
choice_data_list: Changing an idol's direction needs to be done carefully.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
If an oshi idol's vibe suddenly changes out of nowhere,
it'd totally freak everyone out... right?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Falco wouldn't want that either.
An Umadol has to cherish her fans...!
choice_data_list: You just need to keep going as you are and do your best.
You just need to keep going as you are and do your best!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Falco won't change a bit...
I'll keep doing my best to be a cute top umadol!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Falco will unleash her full umadol spirit
and give it her absolute all, so..."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I want you to cheer for Falco
with all your might too, Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"...Ehehe.
Thanks to you, I feel totally energized!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Falco won't lose ever again!
I'll win and deliver the best stage performance ever☆
